snippet.title: Timeslip
snippet.description:
This XBox LIVE indie game was originally released as a Yaroze game on the cover of a UK Playstation magazine. Timeslip features a snail that finds himself caught in a temporal disturbance and doomed to forever repeat the same few seconds of his life. You must guide him through the levels by avoiding his past echoes that appear whenever travelling back in time but also using them to stand on switches that open doors.

http://marketplace.xbox.com/en-US/Product/Timeslip/66acd000-77fe-1000-9115-d802585507a4?DownloadType=Game
